reason: When I need solar I call the installer my nephew used, someone I can see and complain to at his door. A website with strangers' ratings means less to me than what my neighbours say, and I don't want my number going to companies I don't know.
objection: Anyone can write ratings on a website, and I can't see who checked that these companies actually did the work. My son abroad says the same: from far away you can't know what was really installed.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour told me they got a good installer through it, or if the free check of my nephew's installer's quote found something real that saved me money.
